explanations.explanation: This feature fires on structured, list- or table-like passages dense with numeric tokens—dates, counts, percentages, units, rankings, etc.—i.e. text presenting enumerated or tabular data.

This neuron lights up on linguistic cues for direct requests or commands—especially second-person address (“you,” “can you,” “please help”) and negated auxiliaries (contractions like “can’t,” “don’t,” “hasn’t”) that frame questions, pleas, and imperatives.
